title: Write a small event emitter
prompt: Implement the class Emitter in src/emitter.js with on(name, fn), off(name, fn), once(name, fn) and emit(name, ...args). emit calls the listeners in the order they were added and returns how many it called; a once listener runs only on the first emit; removing a listener during an emit does not change who is called by that emit; on and once return a function that removes the listener.
